# Shiv Shatakshi Agro

> Premium agricultural products and crop protection solutions for Indian farmers.

Shiv Shatakshi Agro is an agricultural inputs company based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.
We supply insecticides, herbicides, fungicides, bio insecticides, plant growth regulators,
micronutrients, and wetting agents to farmers across India.

## Products

We offer 57+ products across 7 categories:
- Insecticides (Emamectin, Thiamethoxam, Imidacloprid, Fipronil, Chlorpyrifos, Lambda Cyhalothrin, Bifenthrin, Cypermethrin, Deltamethrin, Profenophos, Monocrotophos, Chlorantraniliprole)
- Fungicides (Azoxystrobin, Tebuconazole, Carbendazim, Mancozeb, Hexaconazole, Validamycin)
- Herbicides (Glyphosate, Paraquat, Pretilachlor)
- Bio Insecticides (bio-based larvicides, BPH control)
- Plant Growth Regulators & Bio Stimulants (Gibberellic Acid, Humic Acid, Potassium Humate, Seaweed)
- Micronutrients (Zinc, Multi-micronutrient blends)
- Wetting Agents (Silicone spreaders)
